# Casa Ta Verde

> Casa Ta Verde is a Romanian home-project consultancy serving Brașov and nearby communities. Its residential solutions cover roofing, HVAC, stretch ceilings, solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, smart home automation, and electrical systems.

The website's primary language is Romanian. The links below identify service sections on the homepage.

## Homepage Overview

- [Casa Ta Verde](https://www.casataverde.ro/): Residential construction and renovation consultancy, project coordination, and integrated home solutions.

## Sisteme Fotovoltaice — Solar Systems

- [Residential Solar Systems](https://www.casataverde.ro/#story-solar): Solar panel and inverter selection based on household consumption, roof area, and orientation, with battery storage and EV charging options.

## Climatizare & Smart Home Integration

- [HVAC and Indoor Climate](https://www.casataverde.ro/#story-climate): Heat pumps, air conditioning, and domestic hot water planning for residential comfort.
- [Smart Home and Electrical Systems](https://www.casataverde.ro/#story-smart): Lighting, curtain and temperature control, intercoms, surveillance, and automated access.

## Huawei Solar & Energy Storage Solutions

- [Huawei and Deye Energy Storage](https://www.casataverde.ro/#story-storage): Huawei LUNA2000 batteries, SUN2000 inverters, and FusionSolar monitoring, alongside Deye storage options selected for equipment compatibility.

## Acoperișuri & Tavane Extensibile — Roofing & Stretch Ceilings

- [Complete Roofing Systems](https://www.casataverde.ro/#story-roof): Metal roofing, gutters, downpipes, membranes, and accessories selected as a coordinated roof system.
- [Stretch Ceilings](https://www.casataverde.ro/#story-ceiling): Matte, glossy, and translucent stretch ceiling finishes with integrated lighting concepts.
